doc: Create future state (research R3) on a two-step stream, as the one transaction the operation makes: future: is created at the end of the file with its trigger first and its outcome after its steps, every copy carries basedOn, the id of what it copies, each new element takes the next free id of its kind across the file, and the flows are copied between the copies. The shown state is set to future, which creates view: after it. One undo takes all of it back.

steps.doc: The operation's edits, planned as one edit.

splices.text:
trigger:
    id: t2
    name: Call received
    basedOn: t1

- id: s3
      name: Log call
      performer: service desk
      processTime: PT5M
      waitTime: PT10M
      basedOn: s1

- id: s4
      name: Resolve
      performer: second line
      processTime: PT20M
      waitTime: PT1H
      basedOn: s2

outcome:
    id: o2
    name: Caller helped
    basedOn: o1
